summary: Applied four spec-review repairs covering completion contract ownership, stale evidence checks, bounded category assignment, and deterministic fix-attempt state.

items.title: Completion contract target is missing for failed-recorded advancement
items.rationale: Added flow-judgment-contract as an explicit module owner and requirement participant for failed-recorded completion.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.modules, overview.decisions, R6, acceptance R6, and T-2 now name flow-judgment-contract completion policy.

items.title: Stale artifact rejection has no observable validation basis
items.rationale: Defined current command identity plus changed-file fingerprints as the durable stale-check evidence and comparison rule.
items.evidence: spec.json data_flow, overview.decisions, R5, acceptance R5, clarifications, and T-1 now describe command identity and changed-file fingerprint checks.

items.title: Out-of-scope and flaky classification criteria are undefined
items.rationale: Limited automatic category assignment to source-backed categories and required explicit proceed evidence for out_of_scope and flaky_suspected.
items.evidence: spec.json R1, R3, acceptance R1/R3, overview.decisions, clarifications, and alternatives now define category boundaries.

items.title: Fix-attempt recommendation state has no data path
items.target: R4 / R7 / Data Flow: Auto/manual behavior
items.rationale: Defined fixAttempts as an observable fingerprint-change count between failed attempts for the same command identity and tied recommendation changes to that count.
items.evidence: spec.json data_flow, overview.decisions, R7, acceptance R7, clarifications, alternatives, and T-1 now define fixAttempts and nextRecommendedAction.
